# Load Libraries

```{r}
library(terra)
library(tidyterra)
library(sf)
library(lwgeom)
library(viridis)
library(ggthemes)
library(tidyverse)
```

```{r}
theme_set(theme_bw())
```


# Load Extent

```{r}
domain <- st_read("./01_processed_data/domain_full_clean.geojson")

# Transforming the CRS from a polar projection to WGS84 causes
# incorrect polygons where Russia crosses the 180th meridian.
# Remove a polygon extending from -180 to 180 prior to
# transforming the CRS to solve this problem.
# Order of the points matters for whether this is a polygon of
# infinite thinness (current) or whole globe (not as written)
split_poly <- st_sfc(
  st_polygon(list(matrix(
    c(180, 0, -180, 0, -180, 90, 180, 90, 180, 0),
    ncol = 2,
    byrow = TRUE
  ))),
  crs = 'EPSG:4326'
) |>
  st_transform(crs = st_crs(domain))

domain_4326 <- domain |>
  st_cast('POLYGON') |>
  st_difference(split_poly) |>
  st_transform('EPSG:4326')
```

```{r}
ggplot(domain) +
  geom_sf() +
  coord_sf(expand = FALSE)

ggplot(domain_4326) +
  geom_sf() +
  coord_sf(expand = FALSE)
```


# Load Raster Data

## TerraClimate

```{r}
terraclimate <- rast(
  '../rts_rep_analysis/input_data/TerraClimate/TerraClimateCompiled.tif'
) |>
  crop(domain_4326) |>
  mask(domain_4326)
```

```{r}
terraclimate <- terraclimate |>
  project(y = 'EPSG:6931', res = 1000, method = 'bilinear')
```

```{r}
map(
  names(terraclimate),
  ~ ggplot() +
    geom_spatraster(
      data = terraclimate |>
        subset(.x)
    ) +
    scale_fill_viridis(name = .x, na.value = 'transparent') +
    facet_wrap(~lyr) +
    coord_sf(expand = FALSE)
)
```

## NIEER Permafrost (Ran et al. 2022)

```{r}
files <- list.files(
  '../rts_rep_analysis/input_data/NIEERPermafrost/NIEER_permafrost_dataset_released',
  full.names = TRUE,
  pattern = 'tif$'
)

nieer <- map(
  files,
  ~ rast(.x)
) |>
  rast() |>
  crop(domain_4326) |>
  mask(domain_4326)

names(nieer) <- c('alt', 'magt', 'permafrost_prob')
```

Make sure that there are only NAs where appropriate.
ALT should be NA outside of areas with a possibility of permafrost (no change needed).
MAGT already has values outside permafrost region (no change needed).
Current NAs in permafrost prob should be 0 instead of NA if there is a MAGT (to ensure we don't fill in lakes). 
```{r}
nieer[["permafrost_prob"]] <- ifel(
  !is.na(nieer["permafrost_prob"]),
  nieer["permafrost_prob"],
  ifel(!is.na(nieer["magt"]), 0, NA)
)
```

```{r}
nieer <- nieer |>
  project(y = terraclimate, res = 1000, method = 'bilinear')
```

```{r}
map(
  names(nieer),
  ~ ggplot() +
    geom_spatraster(
      data = nieer |>
        subset(.x)
    ) +
    scale_fill_viridis(name = .x, na.value = 'transparent') +
    facet_wrap(~lyr) +
    coord_sf(expand = FALSE)
)
```

# Load Vector Data

## Brown Permafrost

```{r}
brown <- st_read(
  '../rts_rep_analysis/input_data/BrownCircumArcticPermafrost/permaice.shp'
)
brown <- brown |>
  filter(CONTENT %in% c('l', 'm', 'h')) |>
  mutate(
    ice_content = case_when(
      CONTENT == 'l' ~ 1,
      CONTENT == 'm' ~ 2,
      CONTENT == 'h' ~ 3,
      TRUE ~ 0
    )
  ) |>
  st_transform(st_crs(terraclimate)) |>
  rasterize(terraclimate, field = 'ice_content', background = 0) |>
  mask(domain)
```

```{r}
ggplot() +
  geom_spatraster(data = brown) +
  scale_fill_viridis(name = 'Ice Content', na.value = 'transparent') +
  coord_sf(expand = FALSE)
```


## Olefeldt Thermokarst Map

```{r}
thermokarst <- st_read(
  '../rts_rep_analysis/input_data/OlefeldtThermokarstMap/data/Circumpolar_Thermokarst_Landscapes_epsg3413.shp'
) |>
  mutate(
    hillslope_thermokarst = case_when(
      TKHP == 'High' ~ 3,
      TKHP == 'Moderate' ~ 2,
      TKHP == 'Low' ~ 1,
      TKHP == 'None' ~ 0,
      TRUE ~ 0
    )
  ) |>
  st_transform(st_crs(terraclimate)) |>
  rasterize(terraclimate, field = 'hillslope_thermokarst', background = 0) |>
  mask(domain)
```

```{r}
ggplot() +
  geom_spatraster(data = thermokarst) +
  scale_fill_viridis(
    name = 'Thermokarst\nLandscapes ',
    na.value = 'transparent'
  ) +
  coord_sf(expand = FALSE)
```

## Arctic Boreal Regions

```{r}
arctic_boreal <- st_read(
  "../../tundra_and_boreal_domain/tundra_and_boreal.shp"
) |>
  mutate(
    biome = case_when(
      BIOME_NAME == "Tundra" ~ 1,
      BIOME_NAME == "Boreal Forests/Taiga" ~ 2
    )
  ) |>
  st_transform(st_crs(terraclimate)) |>
  rasterize(y = terraclimate, field = "biome", touches = TRUE) |>
  mask(domain)
names(arctic_boreal) <- c('arctic_boreal')
```

```{r}
ggplot() +
  geom_spatraster(
    data = arctic_boreal |>
      subset('arctic_boreal')
  ) +
  scale_fill_viridis(name = 'Arctic\nBoreal', na.value = 'transparent') +
  coord_sf(expand = FALSE)
```

## Ecoregions (Dinerstein et al. 2017)

```{r}
ecoregions <- st_read("../../Ecoregions2017/Ecoregions2017.shp") |>
  st_make_valid() |>
  filter(
    BIOME_NAME %in% c("Tundra", "Boreal Forests/Taiga") & REALM != "Antarctica"
  ) |>
  mutate(eco_id = as.numeric(factor(ECO_NAME)))

eco_ids <- ecoregions |>
  st_drop_geometry() |>
  select(ECO_NAME, ECO_ID) |>
  distinct()

ecoregions <- ecoregions |>
  st_transform(st_crs(terraclimate)) |>
  rasterize(terraclimate, field = "eco_id", touches = TRUE) |>
  mask(domain) |>
  classify(matrix(c(eco_ids$ECO_ID, eco_ids$ECO_NAME), ncol = 2))
names(ecoregions) <- c('ecoregions')
```

```{r}
ggplot() +
  geom_spatraster(
    data = ecoregions
  ) +
  scale_fill_viridis(
    name = 'Ecoregions',
    na.value = 'transparent',
    guide = "none"
  ) +
  coord_sf(expand = FALSE)
```


# Combine All Layers

```{r}
env_pred_data <- c(
  terraclimate,
  coptopo,
  modislst,
  nieer,
  soilgrids,
  brown,
  thermokarst,
  yedoma,
  glaciers,
  arctic_boreal,
  ecoregions
)
```

```{r}
env_pred_rescale <- scale(env_pred_data)
```

```{r}
ggplot() +
  geom_spatraster(data = env_pred_rescale) +
  scale_fill_viridis(
    name = 'z-score',
    limits = c(-2, 2),
    na.value = 'transparent',
    oob = scales::squish
  ) +
  facet_wrap(~lyr, ncol = 7) +
  coord_sf(expand = FALSE) +
  theme(
    legend.position = 'bottom' #,
    # legend.position.inside = c(0.9, -0.01),
    # legend.justification.inside = c(0.5, 0),
    # legend.title.position = 'left',
    # legend.title = element_text(angle = 90, hjust = 0.5)
  )
```
